analysis: Both units are base-side text of coordinator/store/postgres.go (lines ~1287 onward and ~2186 onward). No patch hunks or head-side text were supplied, so I could not identify what changed. The base text covers API key CRUD, rotation and authentication (self_route_only, expiry, active flag), usage and inference_routes/request_rejections telemetry, and ledger and balance operations. The ledger code uses the single-statement CTE credit helpers, the advisory-lock CreditWithdrawableOnce, MigrateAccountBalance and the guarded Stripe withdrawal debit. It also covers billing sessions, per-account model pricing and the Privy user and Stripe account records. I saw nothing in these units that is a new regression, and I did not restate any pre-existing issue. Threat IDs relevant to the next pass are T-001, T-004, T-005, A-007, A-009, T-030 and T-031. Items to examine once the diff is available: (1) whether the edits touch the key-validity checks in AuthenticateKey or in the key update, revoke and rotate paths; (2) whether the credit, debit or withdrawal paths changed atomicity or idempotency; (3) whether telemetry or usage columns changed in ways that expose identifiers (T-051). Because the actual changes are missing, this pass cannot clear the PR.
